test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

MKD : IJG

PTF : LSI
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67343de92f677ebd9232d797f5ce1d3570c5842072c4a2eaf1e440cb1277e398.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -4, -1, +3.

MKD : IJG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53a8ed51b2031f95e9b4ed83951dae3a54ea6e61b48e8df9b67e62503a45da4b.png] 

PTF : LSI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5918b408c19ee03a483e588a522ede95f62687de5921088f625e225c889e30c7.png] 

Let's check each option:

1. YUN : UTQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba2dfdb2717abdedf91b55a7c5848d9d79119b699a23f64c3c1f2e271035c44f.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -4, -1, +3.

2. JHE : FFH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8e9eaf4719d100243e9558208c8822ba7e747b517e6e3c6d16a5ab850ece873.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -4, -1, +3.

3. OPA : KOC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d581228823d01e6c1ad2876a5c39673008e0d1831cc1742cc4dfbfb0f025cc66.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -4, -1, +3.

4. NKH : JJJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5a676f2a4d0ead55f1fb04d248384fbe767d6ac1bf776abec6e2d8317b31b29.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -4, -1, +3.

Thus, YUN : UTQ follow the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
